name: Candombe
label: CANDOMBE
source: chico: Wikipedia Tambores de candombe and Paredes (UNCuyo) 2025 fig. 15 after Ferreira; madera: Rocamora (UdelaR) 3+3+4+2+4 and Gonzalez 2023 score; tempo range Rocamora

sources.title: Wikipedia (es), Tambores de candombe: Chico
sources.shows: Chico de 2: each quarter split in four, 's M p p': a sixteenth rest, an accented semi-open hand stroke, two stick strokes

sources.title: Paredes, tesina (UNCuyo 2025), fig. 15 and 18 after Luis Ferreira
sources.shows: Chico: sixteenth rest, open stroke, stick, stick on every beat. Repique madera bar: sixteenths 1, 4, 7, 11, 13 and 16 (the last read here as a pickup, left out)

sources.title: Martin Rocamora, PhD thesis page on candombe (FING, UdelaR)
sources.shows: The clave divides the 16-pulse cycle 3+3+4+2+4 (sixteenths 1, 4, 7, 11, 13); the chico's beat is felt at about 110 to 150 BPM

sources.title: Anibal Gonzalez, Patron de acompanamiento de candombe (agswingmusica 2023)
sources.shows: Madera/clave staff: dotted eighth, sixteenth, rest, eighth, rest, eighth, eighth, rest (sixteenths 1, 4, 7, 11, 13)
